facts.subject: our ten largest end customers
facts.evidence: For fiscal year 2026, 2025 and 2024, our ten largest end customers, represented approximately 96 percent, 96 percent, and 95 percent of our net sales, respectively.

facts.subject: one end customer
facts.evidence: For fiscal years 2026, 2025, and 2024, we had one end customer, Apple Inc., who purchased through multiple contract manufacturers and represented approximately 91 percent, 89 percent, and 87 percent, of the Company’s total net sales, respectively.
No other customer or distributor represented more than 10 percent of net sales in fiscal years 2026, 2025, or 2024.

facts.subject: International sales
facts.evidence: International sales represented 99 percent of our net sales in fiscal years 2026, 2025, and 2024.
